title: Run a customer demonstration and evaluation
summary: When a qualified prospect needs evidence that the product can meet an agreed use case. A customer-reviewed pilot result and explicit purchase, further-test or stop decision.
outcomes: A customer-reviewed pilot result and explicit purchase, further-test or stop decision.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: When a qualified prospect needs evidence that the product can meet an agreed use case.

parts.title: Agree the use case and success criteria
parts.guidance: Confirm the customer sponsor, users, problem, scope and observable success measures. Identify what the demonstration cannot prove and which requested capabilities are unavailable.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Agree the use case and success criteria

parts.title: Approve pilot terms and data access
parts.guidance: Review the environment, data rights, security, costs, support and exit arrangements with the authorized owners. Keep production integrations and sensitive customer data out until their required approvals are complete.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Approve pilot terms and data access

parts.title: Provision the approved test configuration
parts.guidance: Use the authorized account and data to configure the agreed scope. Verify participant access, logging and rollback, and record the product version and setup dependencies.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the reviewed account operation described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

parts.title: Collect reproducible pilot evidence
parts.guidance: Track task outcomes, adoption, defects, support effort and customer feedback against the agreed criteria. Record limitations and avoid substituting a curated demonstration for representative operating results.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Review the outcome with the customer
parts.guidance: Discuss the evidence, unresolved blockers and required commercial or technical next steps. Authorize any extension separately and remove or migrate pilot data and access according to the agreed terms.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Review the outcome with the customer

verify.how: A customer-reviewed pilot result and explicit purchase, further-test or stop decision.

notes.text: This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting. The cited authorities describe their named jurisdictions or frameworks; their rules are not asserted for other countries. External actions require approval for the specific action.
Editorial status: operational draft. Source pages checked on 2026-10-29. No case-specific legal review, professional assurance or completed execution is claimed.
